newsitem.title: USA: CME names former Sen. Simon, two others to board.
newsitem.headline: CME names former Sen. Simon, two others to board.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange appointed former U.S. Senator Paul Simon and two other new outside directors to two-year terms on its board and reappointed three other directors, the exchange said Wednesday.
Simon, a former Democratic senator from Illionois, is now director of the Public Policy Institute at Southern Illinois University.

The other new directors are Paul William Michaelcheck, chairman and founder of Mariner Investment Group, and David Pryde, a managing director and business manager of global exchange-traded products at J.P. Morgan & Co Inc.

Reappointed directors were Donald Butler, chairman of Agrolink Corp; Robert Easton, president and chief executive officer of Stockton Holdings Ltd and its subsidiary Commodities Corp (USA); and Laurence Mollner, chairman of Futures Industry Association who is also executive vice president at DWR Inc and a director at Dean Witter International Ltd.
The CME said the appointments and reappointments were made at a board meeting Wednesday.
It said appointments for two more directors were pending.
